title: AI-Driven Multiscenario Interest Rate Forecasting: A Proof of Concept for Banking Asset Management
abstract: arXiv:2608.12424v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This study focuses on developing an AI-supported prototype for multiperspective interest rate forecasting that combines classical econometric models with modern artificial intel-ligence methods. Tested in a major European bank, the system enables more precise and flexible prediction of interest rate developments, supporting strategic decision-making in Asset-Liability Management (ALM). It integrates topic modeling, sentiment analysis, econometric forecasting, and market-based analyses within an interactive platform. Leveraging AI to analyze large volumes of financial documents and market data enables the identification of monetary policy trends and sentiment signals at an early stage. The core econometric model is a Bayesian vector autoregression (BVAR) that enables simulation-based scenario analyses to evaluate economic developments from multiple perspectives. translated_title: 基于人工智能的多场景利率预测：银行业资产管理的概念验证
translated_abstract: 本研究聚焦于开发一个支持人工智能的多视角利率预测原型系统，该系统将经典计量经济学模型与现代人工智能方法相结合。该系统在一家欧洲大型银行进行了测试，能够实现更精确、更灵活的利率走势预测，为资产-负债管理（ALM）中的战略决策提供支持。它在一个交互式平台中整合了主题建模、情感分析、计量经济学预测和基于市场的分析。利用人工智能分析大量金融文档和市场数据，能够及早识别货币政策趋势和情感信号。核心计量经济学模型是贝叶斯向量自回归（BVAR），该模型支持基于模拟的情景分析，从多个角度评估经济发展。该系统的创新之处在于其整合了多种预测方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合贝叶斯向量自回归与人工智能技术的多视角利率预测原型系统，在银行实际测试中实现了更精准的预测，并创新性地整合了多种预测方法以支持资产-负债管理决策。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a prototype system combining Bayesian vector autoregression with AI techniques for multi-perspective interest rate forecasting, tested in a major European bank, innovatively integrating multiple forecasting methods to support asset-liability management decisions.
